summary: Adds a `significantDigits` option to prettyBytes so callers can change the default 3-digit rounding. It is implemented with readme, types and tests, and the suite passes. No commit or release is recorded yet.
narrative: The owner asked for a `significantDigits` option that changes the default 3-digit rounding (1337 gives `1.3 kB` at 2 digits and `1.337 kB` at 4). It applies only when the fraction-digit options are unset. The agent first mapped the precision logic in index.js, which uses toPrecision with a minimum of 3 digits. It then added the option to the implementation, types and readme, falling back to 3 for invalid values instead of throwing. New tests cover 1 to 4 digits, integer-part preservation, fraction-option precedence and the invalid fallback, plus a type assertion. npm test passes with 55 tests. Memory shows no commit, PR or release yet.
